article.title: 11 terrorists killed in security operations in Panjgur, Chagai: state media
article.summary: Security forces have killed 11 terrorists during targeted operations in Balochistan under Operation Radd-ul-Fitna Three, state media Radio Pakistan reported citing security sources.According to the sources, five terrorists belonging to Fitna-al-Hindustan were killed in an operation in the Gowargo area of Panjgur district. article.title: Security forces kill 11 terrorists during operations in Balochistan's Panjgur, Chagai
article.summary: Security forces have killed 11 terrorists in separate operations in Panjgur and Chagai districts of Balochistan, state broadcasterRadio Pakistanreportedon Saturday, citing security sources.The operations were conducted underOperation Raddul Fitna 3.In Panjgur’s Gowargo area, security forces neutralised five terrorists and recovered a large quantity of weapons and ammunition from their possession, according to the report.Meanwhile, six terrorists were killed during operations in the Aminabad and Siah Chang areas of Chagai district, it added.A significant cache of arms and explosive material was also seized during the operations.According to state-runAPP, Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi praised the security forces for their successful operations against terrorists.The interior minister said the “security forces had once again thwarted the intentions of terrorists through effective action”.The actions carried out by the security forces reflected their commitment to safeguarding national...
